meta.title: Withdrawing Order...: Withdrawing live RFQ succeeds with very long text in the reason field

plan.title: Withdraw live RFQ with long reason

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ with a vendor bid.

args.reason: Withdrawal requested after extensive review of the sourcing event, supplier participation, commercial requirements, delivery considerations, internal approvals, budget alignment, and operational constraints. This deliberately long explanation verifies that the withdrawal reason field accepts and processes a large amount of text without crashing or blocking the withdrawal.

steps.note: Withdraw the live RFQ through the project menu while submitting a very long reason.
Verify that Procol records the RFQ as withdrawn.
